utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I’m free Saturday morning. What time should I come by the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mina, but we’ve moved it to Sunday at the community center. I’d really appreciate your help there if you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I’ll be on the front porch Saturday, and I’ll send you to the first thing that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, Saturday on the front porch. I’ll be there and ready to help with the first fix you point me to.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m free and happy to help on Saturday. Just let me know what time to be on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam. I’m still confirming the timing and space, but I’ll send you the exact time and what to bring as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, we’re still on for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, and I can use an extra hand or two if you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, I can help and I’ll try to round up one or two more neighbors too. Just tell me what time you want us on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — the latest plan is Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. Please keep sharing that update, and let me know if you can help round up a few more neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center and help round up a few more neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia. Just keep me posted on the timing and what you still need covered on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep you posted, but it’s looking like Sunday at the community center now. Once I know what’s still uncovered, I’ll send a clear list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m free Saturday and can help on the front porch. Just tell me what to bring and where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks, Sam — that’d be a huge help. Just bring gloves if you’ve got them, and I’ll show you where to start on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I can do 9 a.m. on Saturday, and I’ll bring work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks, Mina. I’ll see you at 9 on Saturday on the front porch, and I’ll have everything else ready.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
